title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
summary_full: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.
summary_public: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.
